outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar-style schematic showing single computed percentage values (illumination overhead) for each exposure time, not an average across replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a micrograph, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a micrograph, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a line plot (photobleaching decay curves, mean±s.e.m., n=5); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points as this would make the plot unreadable.
Panel E consists of micrographs (grayscale and pseudo-colored intensity images), not a quantitative average plot.
Panel F is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid on the fitted mean curve with shaded s.e.m.
Panel G is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid on the fitted mean curve with shaded s.e.m.
Panel H is a scatter plot with individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid on the fitted mean curve with shaded s.e.m.
Panel I is a micrograph time series, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel J is a line plot showing averaged photobleaching curves with shaded s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
